# <span id="aanchor523"></span> Gas Quality Source Editor

This feature requires the **Source Analysis** module.

The Gas Quality Source Editor is used to create, edit, or delete a gas quality source. A gas quality source is used to gather analysis information which a user can then apply to one or more meters. Typically, the user receives a lab analysis and imports or hand keys the analysis information into a gas quality source.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 284;height: 172;" />

With a gas quality source, you can also take analysis data from a meter, pass it to a gas quality source, and then apply it to one or more meters. For example, a meter is supplied analysis data from an online gas chromatograph. The analysis gets imported into FLOWCAL via the meter import and is then fed to a gas quality source, which is ultimately applied to one or more meters.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 367;height: 188;" />

<div class="procedure">

To access the Gas Quality Source Editor:

Go to **Setup** \> **Source Analysis** \> **Gas Quality**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 626;height: 549;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Gas Quality Source Editor Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Gas Quality Source Editor screen:

- **New** - Create a new source.
- **Edit** - Enable Edit mode
- **Delete** - Delete the selected source. Gas sources can only be deleted from the Gas Quality Source Editor
- **Save** - Save changes; enabled only when in New or Edit mode
- **Cancel** - Cancel edits and do not changes; enabled only when in New or Edit mode
- **Copy** - Copy the selected source and generates a new source, maintaining the general information from the original source
- **Exit** - Exit the screen.

</div>
